lines.label: sign-in
lines.said: Type the email address for your back-office account. [[slnc 800]] Then click Send Code.

lines.label: enter-the-code
lines.said: A four-digit code is sent to that address. [[slnc 500]] Type it in — the screen moves on by itself.

lines.label: dashboard
lines.said: This is your dashboard. [[slnc 800]] A requirement belongs to one store, so we start at Businesses.

lines.label: find-the-business
lines.said: Type the name of a business, [[slnc 500]] then select it from the dropdown list.

lines.label: the-business
lines.said: This is the business info page. [[slnc 500]] Click the lookup icon to find its stores.

lines.label: find-the-store
lines.said: Type the store name, [[slnc 500]] then select it from the list.

lines.label: the-store
lines.said: Now you are on the store details page. [[slnc 800]] Click the gear, [[slnc 500]] then choose Lookup Requirements.

lines.label: requirement-list
lines.said: This lists the store's requirements. [[slnc 500]] Click the plus button to add a new one.

lines.label: new-requirement
lines.said: Give the requirement a name. [[slnc 500]] A good name says which items it is for. [[slnc 500]] Then create it.

lines.label: requirement-details
lines.said: A requirement is a set of questions the renter must answer. [[slnc 1000]] Open the question picker, [[slnc 800]] and tick each one you need. [[slnc 1000]] We add three: [[slnc 800]] the skier's age, [[slnc 800]] their boot size, [[slnc 800]] and the rental agreement. [[slnc 1000]] Then set the status to Active, [[slnc 800]] and update.

lines.label: saved
lines.said: That is the requirement ready. [[slnc 500]] Items can point at it now.

lines.label: back-to-dashboard
lines.said: Head back to the dashboard. [[slnc 500]] You can get here anytime with the command + K short keys.

lines.label: sign-out
lines.said: Click Logout to finish. [[slnc 500]] You are signed out.
